claims.summary: Project Prof (5 arenas, multiverse execution, student-mind state machine, quote-or-discard ledger) is built and produced the standing teachability verdict the release campaign targets.

Same-generation twin protocol: crucible captures project.json on success, twinCompile builds paired fixtures at two git refs sharing a generationId, a1twin judges blind pairs and reports a t-based CI on the delta; provenance guard refuses unpaired packages.

Seam-corruption class fix (idempotence + position guards in artifact label replacement) and grounding slice 1 (schedule core ideas, authored homework, real formative questions, kernel exit tickets) each measured statistically significant teach-as-is gains in paired twin rounds.

Authored-first unit-integrity quiz overlay, printable autograding spec, genre-aware lesson-plan language, coding-performance Bloom tagging, and full-course outcome/alignment coverage with near-duplicate collapse.

Catch-up recap for non-readers (instrument-recognized, compliance loss re-measured 0.209 <= 0.25 bar), 4-concept teaching core, misconception-confronting explanations, behavior-based rubric bands, demand-driven FAQ entries.
